purpose: More recent model fitting and several forward validation months after the first prototype failed its August test
selection_metric: Equal-month mean of average_precision divided by that month's observed late rate
tie_rule: Keep the earlier listed candidate on exact ties
calibration: Fixed sigmoid on the selected family's May/June out-of-time development predictions, not in-sample refit predictions
diagnostic_threshold: F2 on the same May/June development predictions; no capacity/cost guarantee
august_status: Already inspected in the failed version-1 test. Reused diagnostic only, not a fresh independent test of version 2.
constraints: August rows or labels cannot select the candidate, feature set, calibration method or threshold.
The original failed August result remains archived and visible.
Source basket/promise/catalog availability assumptions and conditional observed-outcome coverage limits still apply.
The updated model is a portfolio research artifact, not a production-qualified predictor. Independent new-period evidence is unavailable.
